lines.en: I step out into a living room that I’ve yet to fully familiarize myself with and think for a moment about who I am and why I am here.
lines.zh: 我走进一间还没完全熟悉的客厅，短暂地想了想我是谁、我为什么会在这里。

lines.en: But then I remember that there is a cute girl sleeping in the room right next to mine and that any thought I could possibly have apart from that is essentially pointless.
lines.zh: 随即我想起来，隔壁房间正睡着一个可爱的女孩，除此之外的一切念头，基本都毫无意义。

lines.en: I still don’t know much about Kumon-mi...but what’s even more bizarre is that, somehow, I know even less about the girl who’s been guiding me through it thus far.
lines.zh: 我对 Kumon-mi 仍知之甚少……但更离奇的是，不知为何，我对一直带着我逛这座城市的女孩，了解得还要更少。

lines.en: Well, I guess guiding might be a bit too generous of a word when all she’s really done is provide baseline hints and...vaguely generic information I would have likely figured out on my own.
lines.zh: 嗯，说「带」可能有点抬举她了——她真正做的，不过是给点基本提示，还有……我大概自己也能想明白的泛泛之谈。

lines.en: But I guess now is as good a time as any to try and change that.
lines.zh: 不过，想改变这一点，现在正是好时机。

lines.en: I knock on Ami’s door, hoping that she hasn’t gone out for the morning as that would leave me alone with nothing but my thoughts- and my thoughts have been rather...intense these last few nights.
lines.zh: 我敲响 Ami 的房门，但愿她还没出门——不然我就得独自面对自己的思绪了，而这几天夜里，我的思绪相当……激烈。

lines.en: In a good way, of course. But it’s kind of hard to not have thoughts like that when you wake up in what I’m pretty sure is the early stages of a harem.
lines.zh: 当然，是好意义上的激烈。可当你一觉醒来，发现自己八成正身处某个后宫的早期阶段，这类念头想没有都难。

lines.en: : Come in, Sensei! The door is open.
lines.zh: : 请进，Sensei！门没锁。

lines.en: Good. It looks like my unofficial tour guide and slightly-official niece hasn’t gone out yet.
lines.zh: 很好。看来我那位非官方向导、勉强算官方的侄女还没出门。

lines.en: Now, all I have to do is figure out how to talk to her without sounding like a complete creep. And how hard could that possibly be?
lines.zh: 现在，我只需要搞清楚怎么跟她说话才不会像个彻头彻尾的怪人。这能有多难？

lines.en: : Good morning, Ami. You smell nice.
lines.zh: : 早安，Ami。你真好闻。

lines.en: Fuck.
lines.zh: 完蛋。

lines.en: : Oh! Umm...thank you!
lines.zh: : 哦！那个……谢谢！

lines.en: : Are you sure it’s me and not my room, though? Because I was doing some cleaning a little earlier and sprayed way too much Cleaning Juice all over the place.
lines.zh: : 不过你确定是我、而不是我的房间吗？我刚才在打扫，把清洁喷雾喷得到处都是，喷了好多。

lines.en: : Please don’t call it cleaning juice. I don’t like that at all.
lines.zh: : 请不要叫它「清洁喷雾」。我一点都不喜欢那个叫法。

lines.en: : Hm? That’s just the name of the brand. It’s some kind of deodorizer or something...Which isn’t me saying that my room normally smells bad. I just...want it to smell better?
lines.zh: : 嗯？那是牌子名。是一种除臭剂什么的……我不是说我房间平时臭。我只是……想让它更好闻？

lines.en: : Anyway, if you’re wondering why there’s still stuff all over the place, I’m just taking a little break before I get back to business. I promise it’ll all be gone soon.
lines.zh: : 总之，如果你奇怪为什么东西还摊得到处都是，那是我打扫到一半在休息。我保证很快就收拾完。

lines.en: : Oh, I don’t really care. You can leave your room a mess indefinitely and it really won’t make much of a difference to me.
lines.zh: : 哦，我不太在乎。你的房间想乱多久乱多久，对我来说真没什么区别。

lines.en: : Well, it will make a difference to me since keeping things clean is a good quality and I want you to love me even more than you already do.
lines.zh: : 对我来说就有区别。保持整洁是美德，我要你比现在更爱我。

lines.en: Any amount of love at all would be more than what I currently have for this girl...
lines.zh: 任何分量的爱，都会比我眼下对这女孩的感情要多……

lines.en: But I will keep that to myself for the time being as it’s still way too early for me to do something with the potential to ruin this prospective harem.
lines.zh: 但这话我暂时咽进肚子里——现在就做出可能毁掉这个准后宫的事，还太早了。

lines.en: : But yeah...I should be done with my room by the afternoon. And I handled the living room and the bathroom yesterday, so that really just leaves the attic after this.
lines.zh: : 总之……下午应该就能把房间收拾完。客厅和浴室昨天弄好了，之后就只剩阁楼了。

lines.en: : So is cleaning just...what you do as a hobby or something?
lines.zh: : 所以打扫就是……你的爱好之类的？

lines.en: : Wait a second...is your memory still all weird from when I woke you up from your nap the other day?
lines.zh: : 等一下……你的记忆还是那样怪怪的吗？就是前阵子我从小睡里把你叫醒那次之后？

lines.en: : ...Yes. That is what is happening.
lines.zh: : ……是的。就是这么回事。

lines.en: : Should we maybe take you to the doctor or something? Because if you’re still feeling weird all this time later, you might be, like...really really sick or something.
lines.zh: : 要不要带你去看看医生什么的？都过了这么久你还觉得不对劲，说不定是……病得很重很重之类的。

lines.en: : I’m sure I’ll be fine. I just need to get my bearings a little.
lines.zh: : 我肯定没事的。我只是需要一点时间找回状态。

lines.en: : Never worry, Sensei. Your beloved niece and favorite girl in the entire world, Ami Arakawa, can help you with that.
lines.zh: : 别担心，Sensei。你最亲爱的侄女、全世界最棒的女孩——Ami Arakawa，能帮你找回状态。

lines.en: : To start off...no. Cleaning isn’t a hobby of mine. It’s just something I do because I know you never will.
lines.zh: : 首先……不。打扫不是我的爱好。我做这事只是因为知道你永远不会做。

lines.en: Well, at least that’s one thing the original Sensei and I have in common.
lines.zh: 嗯，至少这一点上，我和原本的 Sensei 有共同语言。

lines.en: : In fact, I handle basically all the chores around here so you can relax to your heart’s content. It’s the least I can do after all you’ve done for me.
lines.zh: : 事实上，家里基本所有家务都是我在做，你好放开了放松。比起你为我做的一切，这是我至少能做的。

lines.en: : I see. So...there’s nothing I need to do to like, repay you for all of your work around here?
lines.zh: : 明白了。那……家里这些活，我就不需要做点什么报答你吗？

lines.en: : Sensei, all you need to do is repay me with love.
lines.zh: : Sensei，你只需要用爱来报答我。

lines.en: : Is there anything else I can repay you with?
lines.zh: : 有没有别的报答方式？

lines.en: : Love is like the easiest thing I could have possibly asked for! Can you at least go back in time to when you remembered you cared about me?!
lines.zh: : 爱已经是我能开口要的最低要求了！你至少给我回到还记得关心我的那个时候啊？！

lines.en: : Yeah, I don’t really think time works like that. But I do thank you for...all of the work that you apparently do around here while I...
lines.zh: : 呃，时间应该不是这么运作的。不过还是谢谢你……显然一直在这个家里忙里忙外，而我……

lines.en: : You can’t even remember what to do with your free time?
lines.zh: : 你连空闲时间该干什么都想不起来了？

lines.en: : Honestly, it would probably be easier for both of us if you just pretend I know literally nothing about this place.
lines.zh: : 说实话，你就当我对这地方一无所知，这样对我们俩都轻松点。

lines.en: : Hah...I’m starting to feel like one of those NPCs that guides the protagonist in the beginning of an RPG.
lines.zh: : 哈……我开始觉得自己像 RPG 开头给主角引路的那些 NPC 了。

lines.en: : I think I know what those acronyms mean, but I’m not sure. So I’m just going to nod in agreement and hope you tell me more about how to live my life.
lines.zh: : 我好像知道那几个字母是什么意思，但不确定。所以我先点头附和，然后指望你多教教我怎么过日子。

lines.en: : Of course. But only because I’m so used to helping you out when you’re at your lowest point.
lines.zh: : 那当然。毕竟在你最低谷的时候拉你一把，我都帮习惯了。

lines.en: : Now, I don’t know exactly how you spend every day...but I do know that you normally try to ration your time so you’re not spending all of it on just one person. But if you do, that person should be me.
lines.zh: : 你每天具体怎么过，我不清楚……但我知道，你平时会把时间分摊开，不会全砸在同一个人身上。不过要是真有例外，那个人应该是我。

lines.en: : Now, let’s see...What are some things to do in the morning?
lines.zh: : 我想想……早上去哪好呢？

lines.en: : Oh. There’s a place called Koi Cafe just a few miles away from here that opened up a couple months ago that you might like.
lines.zh: : 哦，离这里几里外有家叫 Koi Cafe 的店，几个月前开的，你可能会喜欢。

lines.en: : And the school library is also open on weekends if you ever want to go check out a book or something, so...there’s always that!
lines.zh: : 还有，学校图书馆周末也开门，想借本书什么的话可以去……总有这么个去处！

lines.en: : Also, I’m pretty sure the soccer team is looking for a coach as well. But you’ve never really been into sports so I can’t really see you ever going there.
lines.zh: : 对了，我记得足球队还在找教练。不过你从来对运动不感冒，我实在想不出你会去那儿。

lines.en: : And what about things to do in the afternoon? Anything notable? Or...
lines.zh: : 那下午呢？有什么可去的？还是说……

lines.en: : Well...there’s the shrine or the dojo, but...again, I have no idea why you’d go to either one of those places.
lines.zh: : 嗯……有神社和道场，不过……话说回来，我真不知道你去那两个地方能干嘛。

lines.en: : There’s the mall as well, but...
lines.zh: : 还有商场，但是……

lines.en: : I’m going to take a wild guess here and say that you’re assuming I wouldn’t like hanging out in a place like that.
lines.zh: : 我大胆猜一下——你认定我不会喜欢泡那种地方。

lines.en: : Yeah. That’s exactly what I was assuming.
lines.zh: : 对。我就是这么认定的。

lines.en: : You’re not a very exciting person, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你这人真无趣，Sensei。

lines.en: It’s true that none of those options sound particularly appealing to me...but I am not about to allow myself to be ridiculed by a pubescent redhead in bunny pajamas.
lines.zh: 那些去处确实没一个让我心动……但我可不能任由一个穿兔子睡衣的青春期红毛少女嘲笑。

lines.en: But I am also not about to fight back because Ami really is going out on a limb for me here and I don’t want to risk her just...not cooking or cleaning anymore.
lines.zh: 但我也不打算还嘴——Ami 确实是为我费心费力，我可不想冒险让她忽然……不再做饭打扫了。

lines.en: : There has to be something else for me to do around noon, right?
lines.zh: : 中午前后总还有点别的事可做吧？

lines.en: : You...could always just walk around and look for something to do, I guess? Most people are busy in the afternoon, so I have no idea if you’ll find anything you’re interested in, though.
lines.zh: : 你……可以出去随便逛逛，找找有什么可做的？不过下午大多数人都忙，我不确定你能不能碰上感兴趣的。

lines.en: : Oh! You could always come hang out with me! I-
lines.zh: : 哦！你也可以随时来陪我玩！我——

lines.en: : And what about night? What are some things to do around then?
lines.zh: : 那晚上呢？那个时间段有什么可做的？

lines.en: : I’m not sure if I want to tell you anymore if you’re just going to be mean and neglect me.
lines.zh: : 你要是打算这么凶、还冷落我，我可不确定还想不想告诉你了。

lines.en: : I’m not neglecting you at all. I came to you first thing in the morning, didn’t I?
lines.zh: : 我哪有冷落你。一大早我不就先来找你了吗？

lines.en: : You did...but I’m starting to think you would have just left if I kept a pile of travel brochures near the door.
lines.zh: : 是有……但我开始觉得，要是我在门边摆一摞旅行手册，你大概转身就走了。

lines.en: : Hey, if you want to run a travel agency out of your bedroom, that’s fine by me. I’ll be your first customer and everything.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你要想在卧室开旅行社，我不反对。我还能当你的头一位客人呢。

lines.en: : Hah...I really hope your memories come back soon, Sensei. I’m kind of tempted to feed you false information just to confuse you at this point.
lines.zh: : 哈……真希望你的记忆快点恢复，Sensei。到这份上，我都想给你喂点假情报，看你晕头转向了。

lines.en: : Please don’t. You’re all I have right now.
lines.zh: : 千万别。我现在就只剩你了。

lines.en: : I’m all you’ll ever have because I’m also all you’ll ever need.
lines.zh: : 你以后也只会有我，因为我也是你唯一需要的人。

lines.en: : But, when it comes to night time...all I can really think of is the school dorms.
lines.zh: : 不过，说到晚上……我唯一想得到的就是学校宿舍。

lines.en: : Pretty much all of us gather there so, if you’re ever looking to kill some time or come see your adorable niece, that’s where you should go.
lines.zh: : 我们基本都聚在那儿。想消磨时间，或者想见你可爱的侄女，去那就对了。

lines.en: : I’m sure there’s also some nightlife stuff you can find if you really want to...
lines.zh: : 如果你真想找，肯定也有些夜生活去处……

lines.en: : But I’d really prefer you didn’t!
lines.zh: : 但我非常非常不希望你去！

lines.en: : What? Why not?
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么？

lines.en: : Because that’s where I imagine older girls would be. And if you ever get a girlfriend, I will burn this house to the ground.
lines.zh: : 因为那种地方应该都是年长的姐姐们。你要是敢交女朋友，我就把这座房子烧个精光。

lines.en: Okay. I’m beginning to think that Ami may like her uncle a little too much.
lines.zh: 好吧。我开始觉得，Ami 对自己叔叔的喜欢可能有点超标了。

lines.en: : Did you hear me, Sensei? I said I would-
lines.zh: : 你听见了吗，Sensei？我说了我会——

lines.en: : Burn this house to the ground. I know. Which, by the way, is completely irrational.
lines.zh: : 把房子烧个精光。我知道。顺带一提，这完全不理性。

lines.en: : You would think it’s rational if you understood how much I love you.
lines.zh: : 你要是明白我有多爱你，就会觉得这很理性了。

lines.en: : I can’t imagine that’s true. But I doubt you’d have to worry about something like that in the first place since...relationships aren’t really my type of thing.
lines.zh: : 我无法想象那是真的。不过这种事你多半也用不着担心，毕竟……恋爱这种事不太对我的胃口。

lines.en: : Besides, I already have ten girls I need to worry about on a daily basis. I don’t have time for romance.
lines.zh: : 再说，我已经有十个女孩要天天操心了，没空谈恋爱。

lines.en: Seduction, however, is another story entirely. But I’m fine with keeping that contained to my students for the time being.
lines.zh: 不过，勾搭就是另一码事了。但眼下这种事只局限在我的学生们身上，就挺好。

lines.en: : This is the best news I have ever heard.
lines.zh: : 这是我这辈子听过最好的消息。

lines.en: : Because you’re not going to be abandoned?
lines.zh: : 因为你不会被抛弃了？

lines.en: : If you abandoned me, what would happen if I needed to get something off of the top shelf?
lines.zh: : 你要是抛弃我，我够不着最上层架子上的东西怎么办？

lines.en: : What would happen if you needed to pay rent? Or...the mortgage?
lines.zh: : 那房租要交的时候怎么办？或者……房贷？

lines.en: : You don’t happen to know how all of the bills here are handled, do you?
lines.zh: : 你不会刚好知道这里的账单都是怎么处理的吧？

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure that all of our bills are automated since I’ve only seen you use your checkbook like one or two times.
lines.zh: : 我很确定我们的账单都是自动扣的，因为我只见你用过一两次支票簿。

lines.en: : Either that or we’re way behind on every bill we have and will have to go live in an Internet cafe soon.
lines.zh: : 要不然就是我们所有账单都拖欠了一堆，马上得搬去网吧住了。

lines.en: : I’d like to avoid that if at all possible, so I guess I’ll just...look into it on my own or something.
lines.zh: : 能避免的话我想尽量避免，所以我大概得……自己查查什么的。

lines.en: : Okay. And I’ll go back to being a teenage girl who doesn’t fully understand what a mortgage is yet.
lines.zh: : 好。那我回去继续当一个还不太懂房贷是什么的女高中生。

lines.en: : Sounds good. And thanks for all your help today, Ami.
lines.zh: : 听起来不错。今天多谢帮忙了，Ami。

lines.en: : You don’t have to thank me, Sensei. I do this because I love you. Even if you’d rather spend your free time aimlessly wandering around Kumon-mi instead of calling me pretty and buying me clothes.
lines.zh: : 不用谢我，Sensei。我做这些是因为我爱你。哪怕你宁愿把空闲时间拿来在 Kumon-mi 闲逛，也不夸我漂亮、不给我买衣服。

lines.en: : Sorry. I’d offer to take you to the mall but, like you implied, that’s just not really a place that a guy like me would hang out at.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我是想带你去商场的，不过就像你暗示的那样，那种地方实在不是我这种人逛的。

lines.en: : How the heck did you manage to forget literally everything except how to be sarcastic?
lines.zh: : 你到底是怎么做到的，把一切都忘了，偏偏记得住阴阳怪气？

lines.en: : Luck maybe? I’m not really sure.
lines.zh: : 大概是运气？我也不太确定。

lines.en: : But I should probably be heading out. There are a series of places I wouldn’t normally go to calling my name right now, and you need to get back to cleaning anyway.
lines.zh: : 不过我该出门了。有一堆我平时不会去的地方正在召唤我，你也该回去打扫了。

lines.en: : Yeah...I guess I should probably finish up as soon as possible if I’m going to make it back to the dorm by dinner time.
lines.zh: : 也是……想在晚饭前赶回宿舍的话，我大概得尽快收尾了。

lines.en: : And I haven’t even looked at the attic yet, so I have no idea how long that’s going to take.
lines.zh: : 而且我连阁楼都还没看呢，完全不知道那要收拾多久。

lines.en: : Well...good luck, I guess.
lines.zh: : 那……祝你好运吧。

lines.en: : Thanks, Sensei. Have fun taking advantage of your free time and remember to text me every thirty minutes so I know you’re okay.
lines.zh: : 谢啦，Sensei。好好享受你的自由时间，记得每三十分钟给我发条短信，好让我知道你平安无事。

lines.en: : No.
: At least pretend that you’re going to! I deserve at least that much!
lines.zh: : 你至少装装样子啊！这点要求不过分吧！

lines.en: I exit Ami’s room and make my way to the front door to see what else this city has to offer.
lines.zh: 我走出 Ami 的房间，朝大门走去，看看这座城市还有些什么。

lines.en: And while I didn’t learn much about my niece herself (Apart from her...extreme affinity for “me”), I do feel a little more at home now.
lines.zh: 虽然关于我侄女本人，我没打听到多少（除了她对「我」那……极端的执念），但我确实感觉更自在了一点。

lines.en: I’m still a fish out of water at the end of the day- but I’m one of those fish that can breathe on land for an extended period of time and won’t just flat out die within the first few minutes.
lines.zh: 说到底，我依旧是条离水的鱼——但至少是那种能在陆上呼吸好一阵子、不会头几分钟就当场咽气的鱼。

lines.en: Either way, I’m glad Ami is as helpful and reliable as she’s been so far.
lines.zh: 无论如何，Ami 一直这么帮衬可靠，我很庆幸。

lines.en: I can’t see any way at all that the two of us don’t wind up even closer.
lines.zh: 我完全想不出我们俩最后会不变得更亲近的可能。

lines.en: It’s just how close that remains to be seen.
lines.zh: 只是有多亲近，还有待观察。

lines.en: Ami’s affection has increased to [ami_love]!
lines.zh: Ami 的好感度提升到了 [ami_love]！
